content: क्षुद्र {%a.%} [क्षुद्-कर्तरि रक्] (<ab>compar.</ab> क्षोदीयस्; <ab>superl.</ab> क्षोदिष्ठ) .²1 Minute, small, tiny, little, trifling. .²2 Mean, low, vile, base; क्षुद्रेऽपि नूनं शरणं प्रपन्ने <ls>Ku. 1. 12</ls>. .²3 Wicked. .²4 Cruel. .²5 Poor, indigent. .²6 Miserly, niggardly; <ls>Me. 17</ls>. .²7 Diminutive, short. .²8 Trifling, insignificant. .²9 Unimportant, minor. .{@-द्रः@} .²1 A small particle of rice. .²2 A bee or wasp. .{@-द्रा@} .²1 A bee; क्षुद्राभिरक्षुद्रतराभिराकुलम् <ls>Śi. 12. 54</ls>. .²2 A fly or gnat. .²3 A woman maimed or crippled. .²4 A quarrelsome woman. .²5 A prostitute, whore, harlot; उपसृष्टा इव क्षुद्राधिष्ठितभवनाः <ls>K. 107</ls>. .²6 A base or despicable woman. .²7 A dancing girl. .{@-द्रम्@} <ab>Ved.</ab> A particle of dust, flour, meal; अव क्षुद्रमिव स्रवेत <ls>Rv. 1. 129. 6</ls>.
